lines.text: SUB BY : DENI AUROR@ https://aurorarental.blogspot.com/ Are you ready, kids?

* who lives in a pineapple under the sea? * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * absorbent and yellow and porous is he * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * if nautical nonsense be something you wish * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * then drop on the deck and flop like a fish * * Spongebob Squarepants! * ready?
I sure can't wait to drink all these drinks.
April fools' day is Spongebob's favorite holiday.
Mister Krabs, i can't come in today.
I caught sight of the calendar.
There's someone here to see you.
Says he's from the barnacle bay art museum And he wants to honor you as artist of the month.
Yeah, but he told us to tell you...
He told me to tell you April fools.
Well, it's been nice working here.
Just send my last check to the p.O. Box, Mister Krabs.
Squidward, it was just a joke.
No more jokes on you today.
There's lots of other willing participants.
Well, as long as it's not me.
Could you tell me where the forks are?
Oh, but this is a spoon.
Yeah. Give me two large fries and a jumbo krabby patty.
Hey, where'd that other guy go?
What are you doing behind the counter?
Can i get A couple ice cubes in here please?
A couple of ice cubes coming up.
What did you do to my drink?!
You asked for a couple of ice cubes in your drink And i only put in one!
I guess that is pretty funny.
I'm going to show him what a real prank is all about.
Something for me to clean up.
You guys know i was just kidding.
That guy has definitely got some issues to work out.
Why is it whenever i'm having fun, it's wrong?
I didn't mean to make him cry.
I guess this means i better tell Spongebob I'm sorr... ech...
I guess this means i better apolog... ee-Yi!
This is going to be tougher than i thought.
I've got something to tell you.
Spongebob, uh, i was thinking about today and...
And, well, it just seems That maybe i might owe you some sort of...
This isn't something i normally do.
So, so, listen carefully, Spongebob Because i'm about to tell you that i'm...
Patrick, what are you doing here?
Why are you wearing that hat?
I don't know But it must have been pretty good To make him cry like that.
Spongebob, you better let me in there.
I don't want to have to use this.
Spongebob, i just want to say That i'm soooo... rry.
I'm just trying to say i'm...
There's got to be an easier way to do this.
Well, aren't you going to open it?
I don't have a bottle opener.
Spongebob, all i am trying to say is that i am...
Must have been pretty good to make him cry like that.
All right, all right, i'm sorry, i'm sorry.
I didn't mean to hurt you.
In fact, Spongebob, i like you.
I like your foghorn alarm in the morning And your high-Pitched giggling at night.
I also like Gary, Patrick, Sandy, Mister Krabs And all of the other people I'm forced to be in contact with.
Even the part about the lima beans and the car chase?
Yes, yes, whatever But you have to promise not to tell anybody.
What would we do without Squidward?
Behold the ultimate cooking utensil-- The golden spatula!
Hey, Spongebob, look what it says here: "Many have tried to pull this spatula "From this ancient grease and all have failed.
"Only a fry cook "Worthy of king neptune himself can wield...
Take a picture of me and the spatula.
Do you know where the menu section is?
Yes, yes, at last-- Someone worthy of being the royal fry cook!
Who has freed the spatula from the grease?
Uh, i did, mr. Neptune, sir.
You are but a lowly yellow sponge.
Therefore, you could never be fry cook to a god and...
This is why it is funny!
Now step aside while i seek out the true fry cook.
No, not you, you're too short, no.
Yes, you must be my new fry cook.
I don't make them; i just sell them.
Then who pulled up the spatula?
It is even funnier a second time.
You have the physique of atlas.
You pulled the spatula from the grease.
This joke has gone far enough!
Certainly you With your prodigious girth Would know who can flip a burger To suit a royal palate!
Am i expected to believe This creature is royal fry cook material?
I don't suppose you have any proof.
This thing is unfit to even scrub The royal tail fin!
And besides, it's not just enough To pull a spatula off a greasy griddle; There are certain... qualities That a royal fry cook must have.
The royal fry cook must be...
Also, the royal fry cook wears... red underwear.
The royal fry cook's wallet contains His big toes...
He is the new royal fry cook and you...
Is it hot in here, or what?
You're a bully and a liar!
You think you have what it takes to be my fry cook.
You shall be tested with a challenge!
Your friend's arrogance will cost you dearly.
What are two challenges To someone like Spongebob?
There will be but one challenge: You will face me in...
I will accept your challenge If you fix my friend.
See the fate that may lie ahead.
For, if by some minute chance, you meet the challenge Your reward will be great.
Now behold-- My beloved home of atlantis.
You will reside here in this glorious place Cook only for me and be a god!
But if you should not succeed...
You must give up fry cooking...
Ladies and gentlemen Welcome to the ultimate cook-Off!
All right, mates First to a thousand patties wins.
Now go back to your corners And when the bell sounds, come out cooking!
I have total confidence in you.
I'm not good enough to cook in atlantis, Patrick.
I never should have taken the challenge.
Don't give up your dream, Spongebob.
People used to tell me: "Patrick, you'll never amount to anything.
You'll always have your head in the clouds."
But just look at me now.
Fools! Have you no taste buds?
Too chicken to eat his own burger!
But what makes you think his will be any better?
Why, it tastes so good I think i'd like to try it a second time.
So, uh... what do you think?
Therefore, i concede to you-- Spongebob Squarepants, you win.
That repulsive thing In my palace?!
Ah, the only friend you'll need, my dear boy Is the royal grill.
It was nice knowing you, buddy.
I can't live without your burgers.
You're going to be a god And like it!
Maybe we do have a problem.
The accursed stove has burnt my finger.
What did i tell you about using your powers, trainee?
Perfect patties are made with love, not magic.
